title: Global Service Degradation due to WAF Regular Expression Engine CPU Exhaustion
symptoms: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway responses across all traffic
impact: Global network outage lasting 27 minutes affecting thousands of websites.
root_cause: A newly deployed WAF rule containing an un-backtracked regular expression executed on incoming HTTP requests, causing catastrophic CPU backtracking and pinning core utilization at 100%.
resolution: Executed global kill-switch for Managed Ruleset followed by emergency rollback of rule update deploy-2019-07-02.
lessons_learned: Enforce strict CPU execution timeout for regular expressions; mandate staging canary deployments for WAF rules.
source_title: Cloudflare Postmortem: Details of the Cloudflare Outage on July 2, 2019

title: PostgreSQL Primary Database Outage and Secondary Replication Lag
symptoms: High write load on primary database node
impact: 18 hours of downtime for GitLab.com; loss of 6 hours of user data.
root_cause: Manual maintenance script executed during replication lag wiped data directory on primary node instead of secondary due to server hostname confusion.
resolution: Restored database state from LVM snapshot backup after verifying secondary node integrity and re-synced replica pool.
lessons_learned: Automate database failover procedures; implement strict environment sanity checks on maintenance scripts; test backups regularly.

title: Google Cloud Infrastructure and OAuth Service Disruption
symptoms: Intermittent authentication failures across GCE and GAE
impact: 4 hour degradation of Google Cloud services, G Suite, and YouTube in North America.
root_cause: A configuration change intended for a small set of servers in one region was incorrectly applied to a larger number of routers across multiple regions due to automation tool bug.
resolution: Manual rollback of network configuration changes and network capacity isolation.
lessons_learned: Improve safety checks in configuration deployment automation to prevent multi-region updates.
source_title: Google Cloud Status Summary: Incident with Google Cloud Infrastructure

title: Summary of the Amazon Kinesis Event in the US-EAST-1 Region
impact: 17 hour disruption affecting multiple AWS services dependent on Kinesis in US-EAST-1.
root_cause: Adding capacity to the Kinesis front-end fleet exceeded maximum OS thread limits across operating instances in the subsystem.
resolution: Sequential restart of the entire Kinesis front-end fleet with restricted thread pool sizes.
lessons_learned: Decouple service dependencies; enforce hard limits on thread creation per process.
source_title: AWS Postmortem: Summary of the Amazon Kinesis Event in US-EAST-1

title: Database Network Partition and Replication Topology Split
symptoms: Network partition between primary data centers
impact: 24 hours of degraded GitHub.com performance and read-only status.
root_cause: Maintenance on network optical equipment caused a brief 43-second link drop between data centers, triggering automated DB failover while replication was out of sync.
resolution: Re-synchronized read replicas from consistent snapshot backup and rebuilt cluster topology.
lessons_learned: Enforce strict replication lag checks before auto-promoting database secondaries.
source_title: GitHub Incident Report: October 21 Database Partition

title: Slack Service Disruption: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
symptoms: HTTP 500 errors on web and desktop clients
impact: 3.5 hour global outage preventing users from sending messages or logging in.
root_cause: A surge in connections following holiday return overloaded the Vitess database proxy fleet, exhausting file descriptors and connection pools.
resolution: Scaled Vitess proxy nodes and increased connection pool limits across database pools.
lessons_learned: Provision excess proxy capacity for peak re-connection events; add circuit breakers to client auto-reconnect.

title: Global Edge Network Outage due to Configuration Trigger
impact: 49 minute global outage affecting major global websites.
root_cause: A specific customer configuration change triggered a dormant bug in a VCL software update deployed 1 month prior.
resolution: Rolled back configuration update and deployed patch to edge nodes.
lessons_learned: Implement sandboxed configuration validation for all VCL rule additions.
source_title: Fastly Summary of June 8, 2021 Global Disruption

title: Cloudflare Control Plane and Dashboard Outage
symptoms: Database connection timeouts on dashboard API
impact: 4 hour inability for users to update DNS or WAF settings.
root_cause: Database schema migration locked core tables without online migration safety flags, blocking connection pool.
resolution: Terminated blocking DDL lock statement and restored pool health.
lessons_learned: Require non-blocking migration patterns for all DDL in production pipelines.

title: Cloud Identity & Access Management (IAM) Service Outage
symptoms: Permission Denied HTTP 403 on GCP APIs
impact: 2 hour disruption across Google Cloud console and API calls globally.
root_cause: A corrupted cache push caused IAM evaluation policy workers to reject valid permissions due to schema validation mismatch.
resolution: Purged corrupted IAM policy cache and reverted cache distribution version.
lessons_learned: Add schema verification before pushing global caches; improve cache rollback velocity.

title: Redis Cluster Failover and Queue Memory Pressure
impact: 1.5 hour degradation of CI/CD pipeline triggers and background jobs.
root_cause: Unbounded key expiration policy in Redis cache namespace caused RAM saturation and evicted active queue keys.
resolution: Applied volatile-lru eviction policy and flushed temporary cache keys.
lessons_learned: Separate caching Redis instances from persistent queue Redis instances.

title: Summary of the Amazon S3 Service Disruption in US-EAST-1
symptoms: HTTP 500 errors on S3 GET/PUT requests
Internal service dependencies failing on S3 health checks
impact: 4 hour widespread disruption of S3 and dependent AWS services in US-EAST-1.
root_cause: An established playbook command executed with a typo removed a larger subset of S3 placement capacity servers than intended.
resolution: Full cold restart of S3 index and placement subsystems with capacity safety throttles.
lessons_learned: Implement hard safety caps on operational CLI scripts to restrict maximum server removal count.
source_title: AWS Summary of the Amazon S3 Service Disruption in US-EAST-1

title: GitHub Actions Workflow Orchestration Outage
impact: 5 hour degradation of GitHub Actions runner orchestration globally.
root_cause: Database deadlock in workflow state transition table under high concurrent job completions.
resolution: Added query index on workflow state transition keys and adjusted transaction lock ordering.
lessons_learned: Optimize transaction scope in high-throughput state machines; instrument lock contention metrics.

title: Cloudflare Data Center Power Outage and Control Plane Isolation
symptoms: Loss of primary data center facility
impact: 6 hour outage of Cloudflare control plane services, while edge data path remained operational.
root_cause: Simultaneous utility power failure and backup generator transfer switch failure at primary data center facility.
resolution: Transferred control plane database operations to secondary redundant facility.
lessons_learned: Remove single data center dependencies for control plane storage; test cross-site failover under load.
source_title: Post-mortem on Cloudflare Outage on November 2, 2023

title: Google Cloud Storage Service Disruption
symptoms: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable on bucket operations
High error rate on GCS multi-region buckets
impact: 2 hour disruption to GCS read/write operations for US storage buckets.
root_cause: A configuration roll-out reduced the connection pool cap between API frontends and storage backends.
resolution: Reverted configuration rollout to restore connection pool sizes.
lessons_learned: Validate backend connection capacity thresholds automatically before deployment.

title: GitLab.com CI Runner Authentication Failure
symptoms: Database CPU spike on tokens table
impact: 2.5 hour outage of shared CI runners on GitLab.com.
root_cause: Missing database index on encrypted token lookup column caused full table scans on every runner heartbeat.
resolution: Added missing composite index on token table concurrently.
lessons_learned: Require index coverage validation in CI database migration linter.

title: Summary of the Amazon DynamoDB Service Event in US-EAST-1
impact: 5 hour disruption of DynamoDB tables in US-EAST-1.
root_cause: Partition metadata service experienced high membership churn due to network packet loss, leading to request routing storm.
resolution: Isolated unstable storage nodes and restarted metadata authority servers.
lessons_learned: Add backoff to metadata refresh loops; decouple storage engine from control plane metadata server.
source_title: AWS Summary of the Amazon DynamoDB Service Event in US-EAST-1
